# FFL Accelerator

FFL Accelerator is Coriolis's managed ecommerce website for a store. We build WooCommerce on your domain and run it with you. If you leave, the website goes with you.

Publisher: Coriolis, LLC. 109 Brennan Place, Greenville, SC 29609. Phone 828-290-9005.

## What you get
A store on your domain. Hosting, design, FFL checkout, 21 distributor catalogs, point of sale when you want it, email campaigns, and analytics including on-site search. Webmaster included. 99.95% uptime commitment.
